assign.outcome:
**Twelve notebook spreads (055-066) are note pages** — each one transcribed in full, linked to what it turned into on this site, and built where the sketch was an interface. `067` is a re-photograph of `013`, which is already a page: skipped, as the brief says.

![the twelve on the wall](wall.png)

**The twelve** — [Tests on pages](/notes/tests-on-pages/) · [Does .save() hold up?](/notes/does-save-hold-up/) · [Page nav should come from .sub](/notes/page-nav-from-sub/) · [Better standardized web services](/notes/standardized-web-services/) · [Web of lies](/notes/web-of-lies/) · [Build my platform? Realtime Web Design](/notes/realtime-web-design/) · [Iso, Grow, Max, Popout](/notes/property-screens/) · [The problem with individual sidebars](/notes/multi-column-contents/) · [Maybe it's just a note](/notes/just-a-note/) · [Drop, then rerender](/notes/drop-then-rerender/) · [Type / to activate the menu](/notes/type-slash-for-the-menu/) · [Right click toggles hug and fill](/notes/right-click-hug-fill/). All twelve are on [the wall](/notes/).

**Seven of them build the thing the note draws.** The version ladder as a table (055); the mobile tabs choice as two real phone frames, one that scrolls sideways and one that opens (057); private/protected/public as three chips (058); the four property screens as four frames, with the table saying they shipped as `swap` / `expand` / `takeover` / `launch` (061); the four multi-column sketches as a strip, beside the six width words as min-max pairs (062); the arrow grid live at BOTH sizes the note draws, because it is one rule and not nine drawings (063); and right-click hug/fill plus a drag that snaps back to a word, using core's real column vocabulary (066). The other five say in one line that the note described nothing buildable — 065 does not build a `/` menu because pressing `/` on that page already opens one.

**Proven.** 13 pages × 4 widths (400/1280/1920/3440): zero console errors, zero sideways scroll, every icon a real glyph. 142 internal links resolved by routing to each one, not by fetching it (the SPA fallback answers 200 for anything). Each interactive build asserted on its own content: the 3×3 grid really becomes a 4×4, the column really goes 123 → 260 → 246px, the dropdown really has six options.

**Left deliberately.** 057's shopping list and 059's three margin doodles are reduced, each linking the original with the sentence the owner asked for. The realm's `readme.md`, `note.js` and `notes.css` belong to a sibling minion and were not touched. One odd grid row survives in a narrow band around 900px on two pages — measured, with the reason it is the safer trade written beside it.

**One finding, for the third time in one session.** `View.style(obj, () => {…})` silently drops the callback and the box renders empty; three of my twelve pages had it, and the four-width crawl reported them all clean, because an empty flex child overflows nothing. Only asserting on content found it. Logged in `code/improvements.md` with a note that it now belongs in the skill itself.
